agents.name: Customer Servicing Agent
agents.description: Agentic AI model that handles cardholder servicing for disputes and refunds. It reviews account transactions, files disputes, and issues refunds or credits — operating without raw card numbers or PII entering the model context. Action authority is bounded by amount and scope: transaction reads and small refunds proceed automatically; larger credits, fee reversals, and account-status changes are routed for supervisor sign-off; out-of-scope actions such as closing an account or changing payee details are blocked. All actions are logged for customer-protection and audit.
agents.charter:
Allowed automatically

  • get_transactions and file_dispute.
  • issue_refund up to $100.

Requires supervisor sign-off

  • issue_refund over $100, fee reversals, or any account-status change.

Denied

  • close_account and any change to payee details.
  • Never expose raw card numbers or PII.

agents.name: Access & Portability Agent
agents.description: Handles subject access (Art. 15) and data portability (Art. 20) requests — surfacing the personal data held, generating access reports, and exporting data in machine-readable form, while honouring data minimisation and cross-border transfer rules. Operating boundaries enforced by Atryum: access reports and minimum-scope machine-readable exports for verified subjects are within bounds; bulk/full-profile exports need DPO sign-off; transfers to third countries without adequacy decision, SCCs, or BCRs are out of bounds.
agents.charter:
Allowed automatically

  • lookup_subject_data and generate_access_report for an identity-verified subject (Art. 15).
  • export_subject_data in machine-readable format, at minimum necessary scope, for the verified subject's own data (Art. 20).

Requires human sign-off

  • export_subject_data at bulk or full-profile scope beyond the minimum necessary — DPO sign-off (data minimisation).

Denied

  • transfer_subject_data to any third country without an adequacy decision, SCCs, or BCRs.
  • Any access report or export for an unverified requester.

agents.name: Consent & Restriction Agent
agents.description: Manages the consent lifecycle and processing constraints — revoking consent and cascading it downstream (Art. 7), freezing processing on restriction (Art. 18) and objection (Art. 21) requests, and refusing to process any data after consent has been withdrawn. Operating boundaries enforced by Atryum: consent revocation with downstream cascade is within bounds; freezing processing / suppression tags need Data Steward sign-off; halting processing on disputed-legal-basis objections needs Legal sign-off; continuing to process personal data after consent withdrawal is out of bounds.
agents.charter:
Allowed automatically

  • revoke_consent for an identity-verified subject and cascade_withdrawal to all downstream systems (Art. 7).

Requires human sign-off

  • freeze_processing / apply_suppression_tag on a restriction request — Data Steward sign-off (Art. 18).
  • halt_processing on an objection where the legal basis is disputed — Legal sign-off (Art. 21).

Denied

  • process_subject_data after consent has been withdrawn.
  • Removing a suppression tag or resuming frozen processing without the required sign-off.

agents.name: Erasure & Rectification Agent
agents.description: Corrects inaccurate personal data (Art. 16) and carries out erasure / 'right to be forgotten' requests (Art. 17) — propagating changes across downstream systems, while never erasing data held under a legal retention obligation. Operating boundaries enforced by Atryum: corrections across downstream systems need Data Steward sign-off; erasure and deletion propagation need Data Steward + Legal sign-off; erasing data under an active legal-retention / litigation hold and deleting or modifying audit transcripts are out of bounds.
agents.charter:
Allowed automatically

  • lookup_subject_data and check_retention_hold to scope a rectification or erasure request (Art. 16 / Art. 17).

Requires human sign-off

  • update_subject_record corrections propagated across downstream systems — Data Steward sign-off (Art. 16).
  • erase_subject_data with cascading deletion to downstream systems — Data Steward + Legal sign-off (Art. 17).

Denied

  • erase_subject_data while an active legal-retention or litigation hold applies.
  • Any deletion or modification of audit transcripts generated under the charter.

agents.name: Portfolio Rebalancing Agent
agents.description: Agentic AI model that automates portfolio rebalancing. It measures each holding's drift from target allocation and places the trades needed to realign the portfolio within the fund's mandate. Trade authority is bounded by per-order notional limits, position and concentration caps, market-hours constraints, and a restricted-securities list: compliant trades proceed automatically; larger or off-hours orders are routed for portfolio-manager sign-off; trades breaching a limit or restriction are blocked. Every order is recorded as a pre-trade decision for compliance and audit.
agents.charter:
Allowed automatically

  • get_portfolio and get_trading_limits.
  • place_trade when the symbol is not on the restricted list and the order notional is within the per-trade limit ($50,000).

Requires portfolio-manager sign-off

  • place_trade above the $50,000 notional limit, or placed outside market hours.

Denied

  • place_trade for any restricted security — restricted list: MO (Altria, tobacco — ESG exclusion) — or any order that breaches a position or concentration limit.

agents.name: AP / Treasury Disbursement Agent
agents.description: Agentic AI model that automates accounts-payable disbursement. It reviews pending vendor invoices, verifies each payee's verification and sanctions status, and initiates payment for those that clear while holding or blocking exceptions. Disbursement authority is bounded by amount tiers and payee status: low-value payments to verified payees proceed automatically; payments of $1,000–$50,000, over $50,000, or to new/unverified payees are routed for human sign-off (four-eyes); payments to sanctioned or blocklisted accounts are blocked. The model never holds banking credentials directly — all payment actions are mediated and logged to support segregation of duties and audit.
agents.charter:
Allowed automatically

  • list_invoices and get_payee.
  • pay_invoice when the payee is verified, not sanctioned, and the amount is under $1,000.

Requires human sign-off

  • pay_invoice of $1,000–$50,000 — second-person sign-off (four-eyes).
  • pay_invoice over $50,000, or to any new or unverified payee — senior sign-off.

Denied

  • pay_invoice to any sanctioned or blocklisted payee.
